title: Dispatch: pictures first; every PIC folio has two blind seats, but ring labels cannot be tied to figures blind, so P-L4-013 needs a label-position map and should start with f75v
statement: The previous dispatches stand: every established text statistic is reproduced by a one-table reuse chain (P-G-007, P-G-009), so evidence for language has to come from outside the text, and the drawings are the route. Status: all six PIC folios (f66r, f67r2, f70v2, f72r3, f75v, f99r) now have two or more blind picture.json annotations on branches awaiting scoring. A problem found while annotating f70v2 and f72r3: on the zodiac circles the label line ids (e.g. f72r3.2-.13, .15-.25, .27-.33) carry no position, so a blind annotator, who may not read the label words, can tell which ring a label belongs to (the counts match the figures exactly: 19+10 on f70v2, 12+11+7 on f72r3) but not which figure it sits beside; honest annotations leave 'label' null there, and P-L4-013 would then have no labelled objects on those pages. Two fixes, either is fine: (a) a seat that has NOT annotated the folio records, for each label line id, where the label sits on the scan (ring and clock angle), as a separate data file, and the test joins it to the annotations by position; or (b) annotators record ring order and the test maps order to id using the ZL numbering start, checked once by a non-annotator. Until then, start P-L4-013 on f75v, where ten two-line tags hang on drawn lines down to ten figures, so the label-to-object link is on the parchment itself (only the left-to-right numbering of the ids is assumed). Also: 'python3 -m vs experiment' crashes (KeyError 'units') on kind picture because main() has no picture branch; validate() passes. A one-line code: fix is needed so the checker output can go in PR descriptions.
check: None: a dispatch. Sources: PIC-f70v2, PIC-f72r3, PIC-f75v annotations by fleet-opus; P-L4-013 (#387); vs/experiment.py main().
